snippet.title: Hamster Ballers Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
A short, hilariously unfair, two-player obstacle course that'll more than answer the question: "Who would be the weak link if we were trapped in a hamster ball together and had to climb a stupid hazard filled mountain to get out?"

Try the demo for a limited time, and wishlist the game on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4695080/Hamster_Ballers_Demo/
